SELECT
    sum(if(toYear(DateKey) = 2008, SalesAmount, 0)) AS sales_2008,
    sum(if(toYear(DateKey) = 2009, SalesAmount, 0)) AS sales_2009,
    round(
        (sum(if(toYear(DateKey) = 2009, SalesAmount, 0)) - sum(if(toYear(DateKey) = 2008, SalesAmount, 0)))
        / sum(if(toYear(DateKey) = 2008, SalesAmount, 0)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS same_store_sales_growth_pct
FROM retail.FactSales
WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
  AND StoreKey IN (
      SELECT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008
      INTERSECT
      SELECT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  )
